Class MegaDinosaur

java.lang.Object
gamemode.forest.entity.Dinosaur
gamemode.forest.entity.MegaDinosaur
public class MegaDinosaur extends Dinosaur
A large, powerful dinosaur that relentlessly pursues the player at all times.

Unlike CarnivoreDinosaur, which only chases within aggro range, a MegaDinosaur always moves toward the player's center regardless of distance. It moves at a fixed speed of 1.5 units per tick, trading speed for raw power via higher HP and strength.

  • Constructor Details

    • MegaDinosaur

      public MegaDinosaur(String name, int hp, int strength, int expDrop, int requiredLevel, double x, double y, Dinosaur.Rarity rarity, String imagePath, double width, double height, int sellPrice)
      Constructs a MegaDinosaur with fully specified attributes. Movement speed is fixed at 1.5 units per tick.
      Parameters:
      name - the display name of the dinosaur
      hp - the starting and maximum hit points
      strength - the attack strength; clamped to a minimum of 0
      expDrop - the experience rewarded on defeat; clamped to a minimum of 0
      requiredLevel - the minimum player level to encounter this dinosaur; clamped to a minimum of 1
      x - the initial X position in the game world
      y - the initial Y position in the game world
      rarity - the rarity tier of this dinosaur
      imagePath - the classpath-relative path to the sprite image
      width - the width of the dinosaur's sprite
      height - the height of the dinosaur's sprite
      sellPrice - the gold value when sold by the player

  • Method Details

    • update

      public void update(Player player)
      Updates this dinosaur's position for the current game tick.

      Unconditionally moves toward the player's center coordinates, with no aggro range check or idle roaming behaviour.

      Specified by:
      update in class Dinosaur
      Parameters:
      player - the player entity to pursue
